speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me assess this neonate, could you please describe the specific nature of the seizures and any other neurological signs observed? Also, was there any history of maternal infection or complications during the pregnancy or delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of chorioamnionitis, low Apgar scores, and early-onset seizures, this presentation is highly suggestive of neonatal sepsis and meningitis. I will order immediate labs to confirm the infection. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Blood_Culture, Lumbar_Puncture
